notes: Read all 293 source lines (numbered) before editing. The web component is a compact header dropdown for switching saved dashboard layouts with Save-As, Reset and Pin-to-vehicle affordances plus a responsive quick-action toolbar. Behaviour, state names, the active/visible derivations, the pin toggle logic and every i18n key are preserved 1:1; browser-only bits (lucide, cn, window.prompt, document listeners, the web ui/hooks barrels) become native-safe equivalents.

L1 `import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'` -> `import React, {useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode}`: React added for the RN JSX runtime; useCallback added for the native useTranslation/useConfirm hooks; ReactNode added for the NativePill children type; useEffect (PromptModal focus/reseed) + useRef (PromptModal TextInput ref) are retained though the web's containerRef use of useRef is dropped (see L59).

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` -> dropped; replaced by a self-contained native-safe `useTranslation(_namespace?)` returning `{t}` with `t(key, fallback, options?)` preserving every key, English default and {{var}} interpolation (the ChargingListPage/AcknowledgeAlertDialog shim precedent). The 'dashboard' namespace arg (L55) is accepted and ignored.

Accessibility labels + adjacent text carry the real meaning.
